title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Govradar
description_html:
Warum diese Rolle?

GovRadar ist eine cloudbasierte Software zur automatisierten Erstellung öffentlicher Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Lösung sparen Behörden bis zu 90% Zeit in der Vergabevorbereitung, damit Investitionen schneller in die Umsetzung kommen.

Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.


Deine Mission

Als (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager bist du die treibende Kraft zur zielgerichteten Erweiterung unseres Teams und spielst damit eine entscheidende Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum. Du bist Teil des CEO Office und für Kandidaten, wie auch unsere Hiring Manager, die zentrale Ansprechperson im gesamten Recruiting Prozess.
Für diese Herausforderungen brauchen wir dich:

  • Verantwortung des end-to-end Recruiting-Prozesses, von Hiring Strategie über Stellenausschreibung und Pipeline Management bis zur Vertragsunterschrift
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Branding, um GovRadar zur ersten Wahl für Top-Talente im GovTech-Sektor zu etablieren
  • Active Sourcing und Aufbau qualifizierter Talent-Pipelines für verschiedene Rollen in Product & Engineering, GTM und Operations
  • Sicherstellung einer effizienten und wertschätzenden Experience für Kandidaten und Hiring Manager
  • Koordinierung von externen Stakeholdern, wie z.B. Headhunter für ausgewählte Positionen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von skalierbaren Prozessen mit dem richtigen Mix aus AI/Automatisierung und Human Touch


Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level
  • Umgang mit Tech- & Business-Profilen: du bist nachweislich in der Lage, Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichsten Backgrounds zu begeistern, zu qualifizieren und mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Spaß am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld: du hast bereits in einem Startup gearbeitet und siehst schnelle Veränderungen und fehlende Strukturen als spannende Herausforderung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, nimmst proaktiv Herausforderungen an und holst dir an den entsprechenden Stellen Unterstützung dazu
  • Daten- und Tech-Affinität: du steuerst deine Pipeline datengetrieben und suchst proaktiv nach Potentialen für Automatisierung/AI
  • Aufbau von Strukturen: du hast skalierbare Prozesse nicht nur angewendet, sondern bereits selbst von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung mitgestaltet
Nice to have’s
  • Talent Acquisition als neue Funktion von Grund auf aufgebaut & etabliert
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Teamtailor als ATS
  • Vernetzung im Münchner SaaS-Startup-Ökosystem
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem öffentlichen Sektor oder GovTech-Unternehmen


Was dich erwartet

  • Team & Kultur - ein hochmotiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Ownership - ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, eine neue Funktion nach deinen Ideen und Vorstellungen aufzubauen
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung - ein attraktives Fixgehalt zuzüglich performance-basierter Boni, die deine Erfolge belohnen
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen - Weiterentwicklung als Teil deiner individuellen Ziele, unterstützt durch dezidiertes Budget und monatliches Coaching mit deiner Führungskraft
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrides Modell (3 Tage im Büro direkt am Hauptbahnhof), flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit auf Workation
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit - du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Leadership Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact - trage aktiv dazu bei, den Staat in Deutschland handlungsfähiger zu machen und das Vertrauen der Menschen in die Demokratie zu stärken

title: Enterprise, Customer Success Manager
description_html:
About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

Job Summary

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own and shape the post-sale experience for enterprise customers who rely on DeleteMe to protect the highly sensitive personal data of their executives and employees. This role goes beyond traditional customer success: you will serve as a trusted privacy advisor to enterprise stakeholders, helping them operationalize privacy protection, drive adoption across complex organizations, and measurably reduce risk exposure for the people and organizations they serve.
You will partner closely with customers navigating security concerns, internal change management, and reputational risk, while working cross-functionally within DeleteMe to inform product direction, onboarding strategy, and long-term retention. Your book of business will be focused on strategic, high-value accounts with clear retention and growth targets, prioritizing depth of relationship and account planning over transactional volume. As this territory grows, you will help establish the best practices that define what excellent enterprise customer success looks like at DeleteMe.

Responsibilities

Customer Journey Management
-Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle for enterprise sector accounts, including onboarding, implementation, adoption, renewal, and long-term retention.
-Lead structured onboarding and implementation, owning enrollment completion rates and time-to-first-value for each account.
-Manage a clean inbound handoff from Sales and a documented account transition, including a mutual success plan with agreed objectives, milestones, and success metrics established within the first 30 days.
-Maintain account health scores using leading indicators (enrollment rate, engagement, sponsor changes, support trends) and run proactive risk-mitigation plays for at-risk accounts.
-Build and maintain a strategic account plan for each enterprise customer, including stakeholder and organizational mapping, whitespace analysis, and a multi-year engagement roadmap aligned to the customer's priorities.

Value Alignment & Delivery
-Translate DeleteMe's work into risk-reduction outcomes: deliver exposure-reduction reporting and executive-ready metrics that map removals, coverage, and monitoring to each customer's security and risk framework.
-Provide Executive Business Reviews to high-value customers on a defined cadence, revisiting the success plan and quantifying delivered value against the customer's objectives.
-Develop and follow best practices for client engagements, delivering value-adding touchpoints on an ongoing basis.
-Build and maintain trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executive sponsors (for example, CISO, General Counsel, or Chief People Officer) and day-to-day champions, ensuring account continuity through sponsor or champion turnover.

Product Adoption
-Drive adoption across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, including enrollment campaigns, champion enablement, and internal communication strategies for the customer's protected population.
-Act as a product expert for customers, guiding them on new features, coverage expansions, and privacy best practices relevant to their use case.

Renewals & Revenue Retention
-Own renewals and retention for your book of business, including on-time renewal execution, accurate renewal forecasting, and logo-churn mitigation.
-Navigate enterprise renewal mechanics: budget cycles, procurement processes, and multi-approver sign-off, initiating renewal motions early enough to accommodate them.
-Structure and negotiate multi-year renewal agreements, partnering with Legal, Finance, and Account Executives on complex contract terms, pricing structures, and procurement requirements specific to enterprise buyers.

Expansion & Referrals
-Identify and execute expansion opportunities at renewal (seat growth, coverage tiers, additional departments or populations) in partnership with Account Executives.
-Surface mid-year expansion signals and manage a documented handover to Sales, remaining engaged through close.
-Identify referral and advocacy opportunities, contributing to a reference-able pipeline of customers, case studies, and testimonials that elevate the DeleteMe brand across the privacy industry.

Privacy & Security Advisory
-Serve as a subject-matter resource on personal data exposure threats, including doxxing, data broker practices, and the targeting of executives and other high-profile employees, and advise customers on reducing organizational and individual risk.
-Support customer security and compliance workflows, including security questionnaires, data processing agreements, and conversations about DeleteMe's security posture, in partnership with internal Security and Legal teams.

Escalation & Incident Support
-Coordinate urgent exposure escalations (for example, a protected individual who is actively being targeted), partnering with internal operations and analyst teams and managing customer communication with urgency, discretion, and composure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Voice of Customer
-Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Executives, Product, Support, Marketing, and leadership to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
-Act as the customer's advocate with internal DeleteMe stakeholders, channeling structured feedback into product direction, onboarding strategy, and service improvements.
-Maintain rigorous CRM and Customer Success platform hygiene, including account records, health scores, success plans, and renewal forecasts.

Data Handling & Confidentiality
-Handle rosters and records of protected individuals with strict confidentiality, adhering to DeleteMe's data handling, least-privilege access, and information security policies at all times.

Success Metrics
Performance in this role is measured by:
-Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) for the assigned book of business.
-On-time renewal rate and renewal forecast accuracy.
-Enrollment/adoption rate and time-to-first-value for onboarded accounts.
-Expansion pipeline sourced and expansion revenue closed at renewal.
-Customer satisfaction and advocacy (NPS/CSAT, references, and case studies generated).
-Depth and resilience of executive sponsor relationships, including multi-threading across the account and time-to-reengagement following sponsor or champion turnover.

Experience

-A minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or commensurate experience.
-Experience owning renewals, churn mitigation, and net retention targets in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
-Experience managing a focused portfolio of high-value, strategic enterprise accounts, prioritizing relationship depth and account planning over a high-volume, pooled coverage model, including negotiating multi-year, complex contract renewals.
-Experience working with large enterprise organizations, including familiarity with enterprise procurement processes, budget cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees.
-Experience driving product adoption across large, complex organizations and managing sponsor or champion turnover.
-Experience developing deep client relationships to understand client needs and optimize the customer experience.
-Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support to drive positive customer outcomes.
-Experience with project management principles and effectively managing stakeholder expectations.
-Experience within the Privacy, Security, or Threat Intelligence industry is a strong plus; familiarity with security review processes (security questionnaires, SOC 2, DPAs) is a plus.
-Experience with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero, etc) and CRM tools is a plus.

Skills & Qualifications:

-Ability to communicate risk and value to security-minded stakeholders, from practitioners to executives, in clear, credible terms.
-Strong executive presence, with the ability to build trust quickly with senior sponsors and navigate multi-threaded, multi-stakeholder enterprise organizations.
-High degree of discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive personal information.
-Calm, structured approach to urgent escalations and high-sensitivity situations.
-Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication abilities.
-Ability to effectively lead projects and manage stakeholder relationships.
-Positive and collaborative approach to problem solving.
-Preferred candidates are located within the Eastern Time Zone (ET) of the United States.
-Ability to travel up to 20% to support onboarding, implementations, executive meetings, and key enterprise sector engagements.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise - Central
description_html:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Motive, you are responsible for developing and closing business with Motive’s largest prospects. You will sell into the most impactful companies in North America that power the physical economy. We are seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning in the market by heavily investing across all Go-To-Market (GTM) teams within our Enterprise segment. You will lead the charge, selling the value of our products and the business outcomes that can be achieved in partnership with Motive.

Our Enterprise Account Executives sell across multiple industries, including trucking, oil & gas, construction, agriculture, manufacturing, consumer transit, or any other business that requires a fleet of vehicles. You are receptive to feedback, have a willingness to learn, a strong technical aptitude, and a high attention to detail. Because of the collaborative nature of our Go-to-Market team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.

Open Territory: Central timezone (Open to individuals located in IL, KS, MN, MO, ND, SD, WI)

What you’ll do:

  • Prospect and win new Enterprise business through developing key executive relationships within key prospects to drive expansion of that business with all key accounts, growing share of wallet through developing a deep understanding of each client’s business and identifying opportunities for additional collaboration
  • Harness key Executive relationships to ensure RFP wins and grow contractual-based business
  • Partner with the balance of your account team and leverage customer analytics and other available resources to optimize buying decisions
  • Resolve problems, including identifying issues, thinking critically to determine the optimal course of action, and implementing best available solutions
  • Work with technical resources to display to prospects the power of integrations & how our partner ecosystem increases the value of our hardware and software
  • Effectively plan to meet and exceed your ongoing business goals and revenue quotas
  • Develop a deep understanding of our technology platform and operations, using that understanding and market input to bring back iterations to our business
  • Constantly study and deepen understanding of market trends to enable consultative insight

About you:

    • You have deep Enterprise sales experience partnering with F1000 clients
      • 5+ years of SaaS or industry relevant Enterprise field sales experience required
    • You show a strong track record of exceeding quotas and rapidly growing your book over time backed up by data
    • You have an ability to build rapport with executive decision-makers, influencing outcomes through both an understanding of the customer’s business and the unique solutions that Motive can deliver
    • You show a history of working independently with a data-driven mindset for charting a path to short, medium, and long-term sales goals
    • You have best-in-class communication skills, with the ability to successfully convey key value propositions and quick manage objections

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the on-target earnings (base pay + commissions) are:

Bay Area, California

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Other Locations in U.S.

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

title: Business Travel Consultant (Germany-Remote)
description_html:
At Navan, our mission is to power the in-person connections that move people, ideas and businesses forward. We help our travelers focus on being there, not getting there and our Global Operations and Service team is central to this mission!

As a member of our quickly growing Global Operations and Service team, you will be responsible for directly supporting our users’ travel needs. As owners of customer satisfaction, your role is to solve issues, communicate effectively, and collaborate with internal teams to remove any barriers for the traveler - all while providing a best-in-class customer experience. As the front line of our business, you will have a unique opportunity to provide regular feedback to our product, design and engineering teams as they work towards continually improving our customer facing and internal platforms. This is an exciting role where you will have a direct impact on our day to day operations, traveler experience and product development!

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist our travelers with best-in-class travel support through multiple contact channels: chat, call and email.
  • Maintain extensive supplier, destination and system knowledge.
  • Make quick and accurate analyses of customer needs, persona and level of urgency.
  • Provide accurate information for hotel, flight, car and rail bookings, as required
  • Support users with self-service of the Navan platform and app where possible.
  • Respond to customers within SLA expectations and requirements.
  • Follow company and customer travel and expense procedures and policies in addition to global compliance procedures.
  • Provide regular feedback to stakeholders on the progress of goals and performance of key operating processes.
  • Participate in team meetings to stay up to date with new product launches, supplier updates, and industry changes.
  • Build upon your travel industry knowledge to continue to set the standard for best-in-class travel support.
  • Adhere to attendance policy and complete all assigned training.
  • Meet individual performance metrics in support of the organization and company business objectives.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years managing bookings for corporate and leisure clients in a core Business Travel environment
  • 3+ years of demonstrated advanced Sabre or Amadeus GDS experience (ticketing, reissues, voids, cancellations, EMD and MCO issuance/reissuance, PNR management, etc.) is mandatory
  • Experience of local market supplier content and booking practices in both ARC and BSP markets
  • In-depth knowledge of complex itineraries, air fares and fare construction calculations including the use of nett fares, IT fares, route deals and corporate negotiated fares (Fares & Ticketing VAII, formally BA2)
  • Experience of NDC , Low cost carriers and third party content aggregators and their booking management practices is a plus
  • Full understanding of travel industry regulations, along with worldwide compliance requirements
  • Skilled communicator, proficient in both verbal and written English language. Additional language skills (fluent speaker) outside of English is a bonus, but not a requirement
  • Language: Fluency in German (mandatory)

title: Associate Account Manager
description_html:
The Associate Account Manager role is a new and developing function at Navan within the wider Account Management department. Associate Account Managers work alongside Account Managers to provide support to our Travel and Expense customers, specifically to program administrators.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will be working with a team of account managers across different market segments and be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience. Your role will be to assist customers with product related configuration queries, troubleshooting and resolving issues. You will partner closely with our global Product, Finance, Operations and Travel Experience teams to ensure we are delighting our customers and helping them achieve their goals.

We are looking for individuals who have a passion for customer success and account management, embody a “go- getter” attitude, can communicate effectively and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You can expect world-class training and enablement and a fast track towards a revenue driving Account Manager role.

This role will be based in Berlin and report directly to the Manager, Associate Account Management.

What You’ll Do:

  • Effectively partner with your assigned team of Account Managers to support their customers, ensuring excellent customer experience through timely, accurate communications.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our travel and expense product offering to enable programme administrators on the Navan’s product functionality.
  • Monitor and respond to email inquiries from Travel and Expense Administrators related to product integrations and platform settings, travel and expense policy configuration, payment and integration issues troubleshooting and product bugs and feature requests, etc. .
  • Drive satisfaction, adoption, retention, and reduce customer churn risk by providing quick and knowledgeable advice based on customer’s desired outcomes.
  • Handle customer escalations and work across teams to resolve issues.
  • Act as the ‘voice of the customer’ and provide internal feedback on how we can better serve them to maximize customer value and retention.
  • Run playbooks and program ideas to drive adoption and satisfaction and track results based on defined KPIs.
  • Document processes to support the team efficiently and at scale.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar working experience.
  • 1+ year of prior experience in customer success, account management, sales or related customer-facing position within a rapidly growing SaaS company.
  • Passion for customer experience and technology with the ability to deeply understand a product.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts and technologies to diverse audiences including C-level executives.
  • Detail-oriented and ability to stay organized and prioritize tasks and initiatives in a fast-paced environment, as well as problem-solve.
  • Data-driven approach to continuously drive additional efficiency.
  • Highly intelligent, passionate, driven, high EQ, coachable individuals who are excited to delight clients, drive revenue and accelerate their careers.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

title: (Junior) Data Scientist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Quantilope Gmbh
description_html:
Introduction:

At quantilope, we're transforming how the world's biggest brands understand their customers. As a (Junior) Data Scientist, you'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and Software Engineers to build and evolve our AI-powered consumer insights platform. From developing agentic AI assistants and advanced analytics to creating innovative research tools usable by non-technical users — you'll be at the heart of scaling a sophisticated platform that puts automated, AI-powered insights into the hands of researchers and brands worldwide.

We are looking for a (Junior) Data Scientist who delivers production-grade results to high standards, who combines a passion for the latest AI technologies with the engineering discipline to ship them reliably, and who brings analytical and creative problem-solving to new challenges.


What you will be doing:

  • You design and build agentic AI systems using frameworks like Pydantic AI, including tool registries, prompt engineering, grounding strategies, and orchestration of LLM-based workflows across multiple AI-powered products

  • You closely collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and work with engineers to integrate AI and Data Science features into our platform

  • You automate data analytics and insights visualizations that are applicable and interpretable by non-technical users, helping researchers and brand managers work with advanced methods without needing technical expertise

  • You automate the application of advanced market research methods that are easy to use while being statistically and scientifically valid

  • You build and ship machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, LLM-based) end-to-end — from prototyping and training to production deployment in our platform

  • You contribute to our AI observability and evaluation practices, working with tools like Langfuse and inspect-ai to monitor, trace, and continuously improve our AI systems in production

  • You stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI, LLMs, and agentic architectures, incorporate them into your work, and proactively share insights and opportunities with colleagues


Who you are:

  • You have a university degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related relevant field

  • You have at least one year of professional experience in Data Science and AI building production-grade products

  • You have production-level experience building agentic AI systems or LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, tool-use patterns, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar approaches

  • You have strong programming skills in Python and proficiency with relevant frameworks and libraries (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic/Pydantic AI, Pytest, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) as well as experience with LLM integration (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers)

  • You have experience in the software industry including delivering high-quality, scalable services via APIs to production

  • You write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code — you're comfortable working in a professional codebase with code reviews, automated testing (e.g., Pytest), and CI/CD practices

  • You are an excellent and creative problem solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and change and who is curious to learn new tools, technologies, and domains

  • You are fluent in English with excellent communication skills — including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and to work effectively in cross-functional teams


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure for software deployment (Kubernetes, Helm) and AI observability tooling (Langfuse, LLM tracing)

  • Experience in or passion for the area of market research, marketing, or consumer insights


Benefits of working at quantilope:

  • Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?

  • Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel. 

  • Wellness is key: We offer Private Health Insurance & Pension plan options as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.

  • Diverse & inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.
     
  • Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way. 

#DNI

description_html:
OUR ORIGIN STORY

In 2011 SkySlope started as an idea born at the kitchen table of our CEO, with just him and two others. Headquartered in Sacramento, California, we have since grown out of our previous 3 offices and many of our close to 150 employees are spread all across the United States. Those 150 employees support close to 300,000 users across 5,000 offices nationwide and now in Canada as well. Included in that is 8 out of the 15 largest Real Estate Brokerages in the nation.

But, despite being happy with what we’ve achieved we know that as industry leaders in our space there’s a lot of work left to be done. All of the growth and success that has happened is a result of us obsessing over building cutting edge software that makes the Real Estate world a better place. We know this only happens by hiring people who don’t just come up with out of the box ideas but hiring people who actually see those ideas through and bring them to life. As we’ve grown, we’ve been fortunate enough to hire plenty of people who possess that quality and realize it’s equally important to hire people who can pair that skill with empathy, collaboration, and a keen sense of urgency. If you’re looking to join a company where you can have real impact and surround yourself with an incredible team of people then look no further.

SKYSLOPE’S CORE VALUES

These are the principles that helped us get to where we are and they are the principles that will guide us to where we want to go in the future. You can apply them to your professional life, your personal life, to any business and any situation. In no specific hierarchy, our core values are:

Awareness | Execution | Obsession | Ownership | Humility | Radical Candor | Urgency | Greatness | Inches I Fun

Learn more about our core values from our CEO, Tyler Smith here!

Purpose: The purpose of the Security Engineering Manager is to build and lead SkySlope's dedicated security engineering team in pursuit of making life better for every real estate agent, broker and service provider. This is a player-coach role: they will design the security engineering program, own its execution, hire and grow the team that delivers it, and stay hands-on in the technical work throughout. SkySlope is making a significant, sustained investment in security engineering, and this role is the foundation of that investment.

Why This Role: This is a genuine greenfield leadership opportunity. You are not inheriting someone else's program, tooling decisions, or org chart. You will design the program, pick the tools, hire the team, and set the standards, with direct executive sponsorship and a Director of Engineering who currently leads the security function and is invested in your success. SkySlope is also an aggressively pro-AI engineering organization: we treat AI as a security force multiplier for review, triage, and detection engineering, operating within guardrails you will help define. If you want to build a modern security program from first principles, with AI in the toolbox rather than on the threat slide, this is that role.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  1. Responsible for designing and executing SkySlope's security engineering program.

    1. Own the security roadmap across its major domains: identity and credential standards (short-lived, machine-identity-based credentials and OIDC federation), least-privilege authorization, secrets management, managed-device standards, attack-surface governance, secure SDLC (commit signing and org-wide SAST, dependency and secret scanning), centralized logging and detection, vulnerability disclosure, and AI governance.

    2. Sequence and prioritize the program pragmatically, targeting the highest risk reduction per unit of engineering effort first.

    3. Own the security-debt register: maintain security work as a visible, prioritized engineering backlog rather than an audit artifact.

    4. Own security tooling and vendor decisions, including evaluation, selection, and build-vs-buy judgment.

    5. Deliver clear, honest executive reporting on program status, risk posture, and progress.

  1. Responsible for hands-on technical leadership (player-coach).

    1. Lead and participate directly in architecture and design reviews for security-relevant work.

    2. Contribute hands-on where it matters most: proofs of concept, detection logic, automation, and reviews.

    3. Set and uphold the technical bar for security engineering work across the team.

  1. Responsible for hiring and growing the security team.

    1. Hire security engineers across levels and build an effective, collaborative team.

    2. Coach and mentor each direct report through personal and performance management, including growing an early-career engineer into a strong contributor.

    3. Build a team culture where security work is engineering work: shipped, measured, and iterated.

  1. Responsible for partnering across the organization.

    1. Work with DevOps, IT, and product engineering teams to embed security standards into how work already gets done — paved roads over gates.

    2. Communicate early and often, building trust between security and the rest of engineering.

    3. Ensure security guidance is concrete and actionable, not theoretical.

  1. Responsible for making AI a security force multiplier.

    1. Apply AI tooling to security review, triage, and detection engineering, and define the guardrails under which it operates.

    2. Shape SkySlope's AI governance standards in partnership with engineering leadership.

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Measurables:

  • Security program milestones defined, communicated, and delivered

  • Security-debt register established and demonstrably burning down

  • Team hired, retained, and growing (manager and peer observations)

  • Quality and clarity of executive reporting

Experience and Qualities:

  • Strong senior/staff-level individual contributor background in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering; you have personally built the kinds of systems you will now lead

  • Demonstrated ability to design and drive a security program or comparable cross-cutting technical initiative from ambiguity to delivery

  • Working depth in modern cloud security practice: cloud IAM, credential federation, secrets management, secure SDLC, and detection/logging (we run multi-cloud: primarily AWS, a growing GCP footprint, and a small amount of Azure; depth in one cloud and fluency across the rest is fine)

  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, with a track record of growing engineers, including those early in their careers

  • Sound judgment on tooling and vendor decisions, including knowing when to build and when to buy

  • Clear, direct communicator with executives and with engineers, in writing and in person

  • Enthusiasm for using AI as a working tool in security engineering; we want practitioners who are energized by this, not skeptical of it

  • Pragmatism: bias toward risk reduction that ships over frameworks that impress

    • We care about demonstrated ability, not certifications or credentials. If you've built and led this kind of work, we want to talk to you regardless of which letters follow your name.

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position has 2-4 direct reports, including security engineers at multiple levels.

title: Customer Support Representative
description_html:
About DeleteMe, The Online Privacy Company

DeleteMe is a rapidly growing SaaS privacy business operating globally and remotely – we are the emerging leader based on customers and revenues in a fast-growing nascent category of consumer and enterprise security Privacy Services. What we do - our mission - matters because we are restoring a sense of privacy, fairness, and control to personal data in the possession of others. Easier, simpler, control underpinned by a suite of new data privacy laws being passed worldwide will play a part in greater personal security, freedom, and in stronger democracies in an era where data collection is at unprecedented levels. This is what our work and brand stand for and we are building a large, sustainable, for-profit business to catalyze this. We have strong B2C and B2B businesses with respective product offerings informed by feedback from an active customer base growing between 30% and 200% year/year. DeleteMe is well-capitalized: profitable for the last three years with an 8-figure balance sheet and large-scale venture firms as investors.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate team, backed by premier investment firms, and supercharged by a strong mission to empower consumers with privacy.

Job Title:

CUSTOMER SUPPORT REPRESENTATIVE

Job Summary:

The Customer Support Representative reports directly to the Team Leader. This role involves interacting with existing and potential customers. After extensive training in this role, the CSR will respond to support requests via Zendesk to resolve support concerns and answer pre-sale inquiries.

Partner with internal teams to resolve complex issues while championing our customers’ needs throughout the process

Resolve inquiries received via web, email, and internal ticketing system in a timeframe consistent with department and team service levels and goals

Identify potential user interface issues and elevate for resolution

Elevate customer issues that cannot be resolved to the Deleteme Support team leader

Job Requirements:

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including written skills

Adept troubleshooting, problem-solving, and critical thinking

Passion for learning and an ability to communicate complex issues in a clear and educational manner

Ability to adapt to rapid changes in the workplace

Proficient in using technology and navigating multiple systems

title: Project Manager
description_html:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Project Manager to join our Solutions Engineering team. This client-facing role will coordinate all aspects of customer engagements, from strategic demonstrations, implementations and integrations through ongoing technical support. Partnering closely with Solutions Engineers, this individual will ensure successful pre- and post-sales delivery of Echodyne solutions while keeping customer satisfaction, timelines, and quality outcomes at the forefront.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as the primary coordinator for prospect and customer delivery projects, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and execution across multiple stakeholders.
  • Manage the planning, scheduling, and delivery of implementations, integrations, and other technical engagements.
  • Serve as the customer’s point of contact for project progress, issues, and escalations.
  • Work closely with Solutions Engineers, Sales, and Product teams to ensure commitments are understood, scoped, and met.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, status updates, and documentation.
  • Track project milestones, dependencies, and risks; proactively address issues to keep projects on schedule.
  • Support pre-sales activities by advising on delivery timelines, resource needs, and customer requirements.
  • Build strong relationships with customers to ensure a positive experience and long-term engagement.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience) is desired.
  • 5+ years of experience in project management, technical program management, or services delivery, ideally in a technology or engineering environment.
  • Proven experience managing customer-facing projects with multiple technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Familiarity with radar, sensors, aerospace/defense, or related technology industries is a plus.
  • Experience working with government or defense customers is strongly preferred.
  • PMP, Scrum Master, or other project management certification is desirable but not required.
  • Moderate travel may be required.

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

This is an exempt role:

The expected annual salary range for this role is

$104,030—$155,839 USD

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:

  • RSU (Restricted Stock Units)
  • Generous Benefits:
    • Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you
      • Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA
      • Virtual Care – 98Point6
      • Employee Assistance Program
  • Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)
  • Travel Assistance Insurance
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Short & Long Term Disability
  • Flexible PTO (exempt) / 15 days per year (non-exempt)
  • 401(k) match
  • Pet Insurance
  • Prepaid Legal Program
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Paid Company Holidays

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Director, Growth
description_html:
About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

Job Title: Director, Growth

Job Summary:

Attacker Doesn't Sleep. Neither Should Our GTM Stack.
DeleteMe helps people and companies delete the personal data that fuels phishing, doxxing, and AI-powered social engineering attacks. We're the category leader in personal data removal — and we're now defining the next category: Human Attack Surface Management (HASM).

We move fast, ship faster, and think in systems, not tickets. We're looking for a Director of Growth who doesn't just manage marketing campaigns but a AI-native growth machine.

If "growth hacking” to you means Zapier and a few HubSpot workflows, this isn't your role. If it means dynamic campaigns, agentic pipelines, LLM-orchestrated lead scoring, and infrastructure that gets smarter every week without a headcount increase, keep reading.

Responsibilities:

-You'll sit at the intersection of marketing, sales, RevOps, and data — but you'll operate like a growth hacker, not a coordinator.
-Build the AI-native GTM stack: Design and own the systems architecture connecting our CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, intent data, and outbound motion — with AI agents doing the work humans used to do manually.
-Automate the funnel, end to end: From lead scoring and routing to personalization at scale, you'll build pipelines that use LLMs and agentic workflows to make every touch smarter than the last.
-Instrument everything: Attribution, pipeline velocity, campaign performance — you'll build the dashboards and data models that let leadership make real-time decisions, not monthly ones.
-Prototype relentlessly: You'll stand up scrappy internal tools and agents in days, not quarters — proving value fast, then hardening what works.
-Partner cross-functionally: You'll work directly with marketing leadership (including our CMO) on campaigns like our co-branded research initiatives with 451 Research/S&P Global, translating category-defining content strategy into scalable, systemized execution.
-Build the team: You'll start as a builder and grow into a leader — hiring and mentoring GTM engineers who share your obsession with automation and speed.

Experience:

-You're AI-first, not AI-curious: You've built real workflows with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and automation tooling — not just used ChatGPT to write emails. You have opinions about prompt architecture, context windows, and where agents fail.
-You code: Python, SQL, and API-level fluency are table stakes. You're comfortable in a CRM's data model and in a Jupyter notebook in the same afternoon.
-You've lived in the GTM stack: Salesforce or HubSpot, Clay, Outreach/Salesloft, 6sense/ZoomInfo, Segment — you know how these systems actually talk to each other (and where they lie to each other).
-You think like a founder: You default to building over buying, shipping over planning, and you measure your own impact in pipeline and velocity, not activity.
-You've done this before: 5+ years in GTM/RevOps/marketing engineering, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or security company, with real ownership of systems and outcomes.
-You're allergic to bureaucracy: You'd rather build the automation than write the ticket asking someone else to.
-Bonus: experience in security, privacy, or risk categories — you understand urgency-driven buyers and how to build pipeline around a category the market is still learning to name.

What We Offer:

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, location, employment status, and other factors.

  • Comprehensive health benefits - Medical, Vision, Dental
  • 401k retirement plan
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • 20 days of Paid Time Off
  • 11 Company-Paid Holidays
  • Birthday Off
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Cell Phone Reimbursement
  • Fitness Membership Reimbursement
  • Child Care Reimbursement
  • DeleteMe Gold Membership
  • Discounted DM Plans for Friends and Family

Compensation

Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

title: Customer Care & Claims Agent Netherlands (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Alteos
description_html:
These tasks are waiting for you

  • You're the first point of contact for our customers and partners in the Netherlands. You take calls and emails, log them properly, and like to sort things out right on the first contact.
  • You take on new claims cases yourself and keep an eye on them proactively, so nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Being reachable and hitting our service levels isn't down to luck for you, it's the result of how independently and responsibly you work.
  • You make sure our customers and partners can always understand how and why we make our decisions.
  • Our CRM (Hubspot) and our self-built contract management system are in good hands with you, you use and maintain both actively.
  • Together with our Operations team, you keep fine-tuning our processes so things run more smoothly for customers, partners, and us internally.


This is what you bring to the table

  • Dutch is your mother tongue and you're fluent in English. German is a nice bonus, but not a must.
  • You bring experience in customer service, customer care, or a service center, and ideally you've already spent some time in the insurance industry.
  • Customer focus, decisiveness, and assertiveness aren't foreign concepts to you, and you communicate really well.
  • You're simply a friendly, open person who enjoys talking, writing, and chatting with customers.
  • Nice to have: you've already worked in a B2B environment, you're interested in our products, you're tech-savvy, and you use AI tools naturally to work more efficiently.

Do you have different experiences, but think you're the right person for this role? Feel free to apply anyway — we'd love to hear why you'd be a great fit.


What we offer

Together with our investor, AXA, we offer a combination of entrepreneurial freedom, leading technological know-how, reliability and extensive experience in the conception and management of insurance solutions that is rather unusual for the insurance industry.

When you become part of our team, you can expect to work with incredibly versatile and talented colleagues.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of insurance by contributing to the strategy and success of Alteos and further advancing one of the worlds leading core insurance systems
  • Modern working in the middle of Berlin's City-West, with a wide range of perks and benefits. To name a few: subsidized lunch, discount on BVG ticket, company (e-)bike leasing, urban sports club, mental well-being app, and - if needed/wanted- Visa and relocation support 
  • Many opportunities to connect with your colleagues outside of daily work, e.g.through team events, weekly yoga classes, team runs and more
  • A flexible work model (hybrid working role)

title: Senior Accountant/ Finance Specialist (m/w/d) - remote
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Studysmarter
description_html:
Deine Rolle

Du bist unser zentraler Finance Point of Contact - die Person, bei der alle Fäden zusammenlaufen. Du verantwortest das komplette operative Finance, baust dir die Prozesse dafür selbst auf und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt. 

Du bekommst echte Ownership, maximale Autonomie und die Chance, Finance so zu gestalten, wie du es für richtig hältst.

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt. 

Aufgaben:

Operatives Finance

  • Kreditoren- & Debitorenbuchhaltung: Rechnungslauf, Belegprüfung, Mahnwesen.

  • Zahlungsverkehr & Banken: Tagesgeschäft, Kontoauszüge, Abstimmungen.

  • Reisekosten & Spesen: Teamausgaben effizient über moderne Tools (z. B. Spendesk).

  • Umsatzabgleich: App Store, Google Play und PayPal mit Kontoeingängen abstimmen.

Steuerberatung & Behörden

  • Zentrale Anlaufstelle und enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatungskanzlei.

  • Ansprechperson bei Betriebsprüfungen und Wirtschaftsprüfer-Audits.

Zusammenarbeit mit den Departments

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen, allen voran Sales: Deal-Abstimmungen, Provisions-/Bonus-Themen, laufender Austausch zu Zahlen.

Payroll & Vergütung

  • Sales-Bonus-Berechnung und Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung vorbereiten, prüfen und freigeben – inkl. internationale Payroll (u. a. Deel).

Abschlüsse & Compliance

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB, Budgetierung/Financial Planning.

Prozesse & Systeme

  • Einführung von Scopevisio als neuem Finance-System, Pflege der Stammdaten.

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse.

Automatisierung & KI

  • Du entscheidest, wo sich Automatisierung wirklich lohnt, und baust entsprechende Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Tools.

  • Aktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools, um wiederkehrende Aufgaben effizienter zu machen.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährig, idealerweise als Alleinverantwortliche:r über mehrere Finance-Disziplinen hinweg (Buchhaltung, Payroll, Abschlüsse).

  • Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware wie DATEV ist Pflicht; Erfahrung mit Tools wie Scopevisio, Spendesk oder HubSpot (als CRM/Buchungstool im Zusammenspiel mit Sales) ist von Vorteil.

  • Mindset: Digital- und AI-affin, nutzt KI-Tools aktiv zur Effizienzsteigerung.

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständig, proaktiv, mit echtem Ownership.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

  • Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

  • Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz.
  • Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber.
  • Chancen bewerten und priorisieren. Du schätzt vorher ab, was realistisch drin ist und was es bringt, und bringst eine Shortlist ins Team. 
  • Selbst bauen und selbst live stellen. Du baust Landing Pages, Tests und Kampagnenbausteine mit AI und veröffentlichst sie selbst. Kein Ticket bei Engineering, kein Warten auf Design, keine Warteschlange. 
  • Testen und messen. Du setzt A/B-Tests auf der Website, in den App Stores und auf unseren weiteren Plattformen auf, wertest sie sauber aus und iterierst. 
  • App Store Optimisation. Du testest Screenshots, Icon, Titel und Beschreibungen laufend weiter.
  • Akquisition und früher Funnel. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Gewinnung neuer Nutzer. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Team bewertet Ihr, welche Zielgruppen und Kanäle den besten LTV bringen, und verbessert danach die Signup- und Activation-Flows im frühen Funnel.
  • Copy und Botschaften. Du formulierst, was StudySmarter Lernenden bringt, so dass es bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommt und konvertiert. Headlines auf Landing Pages, Ad-Copy, Video-Skripte, Plakatmotive und mehr. 
  • Content und Kampagnen mit AI. AI-Content-Projekte, Markenaufbau für unsere Jobboards, Out-of-Home-Kampagnen.
  • Love Brand aufbauen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns eine globale Love Brand für B2C und B2B und prägst mit, wie StudySmarter aussieht und klingt.


Was die Rolle nicht ist

  • Keine klassische Designstelle. Geschmack und Markenurteil sind wichtig, die handwerkliche Ausführung läuft über AI und Freelancer.
  • Kein Performance-Marketing-Job. Kanäle, Budget, Bidding und Attribution liegen an anderer Stelle im Team.
  • Keine Briefing-Rolle. Du machst die Arbeit selbst, statt sie weiterzugeben.
  • Keine Product-Rolle. Du bist kein Product Manager. Du trägst die Nutzerakquisition und arbeitest dafür eng mit dem Product Team zusammen, ohne Produktverantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Keine Führungsrolle. Du arbeitest eng im Marketing-Team und gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam, führst aber keine eigenen Mitarbeitenden. Dafür deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Starke AI-Skills. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude Code, Codex oder ähnlichen, dazu mit Agents und Automatisierung. Du baust eigene Seiten, Tools und Workflows und bringst sie selbst live, statt nur Prompts zu schreiben.
  • Starkes Copywriting und Storytelling. Du schreibst Texte, die auffallen und konvertieren, und findest die
    Worte, die bei Schülerinnen, Schülern und Studierenden ankommen. Du denkst in Geschichten und Nutzen, nicht in Feature-Listen.
  • Eigenständigkeit und Tempo. Du nimmst ein Thema und bringst es durch. Zehn Dinge live und gemessen sind Dir lieber als zwei perfekte. Zahlenverständnis. Du liest Funnel selbst, arbeitest in Analytics-Tools und bewertest Tests ehrlich, auch wenn
    das Ergebnis gegen Deine Idee spricht.
  • Ein Auge für Design. Du erkennst, was gut aussieht und was nicht, und kannst einschätzen, wann Design
    Conversion bringt und wann es nur Dekoration ist. Figma ist Dir vertraut.
  • Marketing-Grundverständnis. Du weißt, wie Paid, SEO und Lifecycle grundsätzlich funktionieren. Die Details der einzelnen Kanäle lernst Du bei uns.
Zwei Dinge sind Voraussetzung:
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Du schreibst für unsere Zielgruppe auf Landing Pages, in
    Ads, in den App Stores und offline. Ohne echtes Sprachgefühl funktioniert das nicht.
  • Eigene Projekte, die Du zeigen kannst. Seiten, Tools, Content, Nebenprojekte. Das sagt uns
    mehr als ein Lebenslauf.

Wir schauen auf Skills, Execution, Tempo, Kreativität und Ambition, nicht auf die Anzahl der Berufsjahre. Starke
Absolventinnen und Absolventen sind ausdrücklich willkommen, ebenso Profile mit einigen Jahren Erfahrung.


Warum StudySmarter?

  • Remote arbeiten, so viel Du möchtest
  • Modernes Büro mit Terrasse, mitten im Münchner Werksviertel
  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg
  • Ausstattung nach Deiner Wahl
  • Direkter Draht zu den Foundern
  • EGYM Wellpass für Sport und Gesundheit
  • Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und Getränke-Flatrate
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, Sommer- und
  • Weihnachtsfeier
  • Budget für Fortbildung und Weiterentwicklung
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Du AI nicht rechtfertigen musst


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV und Links zu AI-Projekten, die Du verantwortet hast. Ein Anschreiben ist optional. Und zeig uns etwas, das Du in den letzten drei Monaten mit AI gebaut hast. Ein paar Absätze oder ein kurzes Video genügen.

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Erfahrungen und Perspektiven und ermutigen alle Menschen, sich zu
bewerben, auch wenn nicht jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt ist. Wenn Du unsicher bist, ob Dein Profil passt,
bewirb Dich und lass es uns beurteilen.

title: Senior Project Manager - Digital Communications (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Init Ag
description_html:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content.
Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs.
  • Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen.
  • Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter.
  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.
  • Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen.
  • Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs.
  • Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss.
  • Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus Projekten im Public Sector oder in public-nahen Branchen mit.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings und Zertifizierungen entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Anne Kroll

  • Du kennst die aktuellen Digitalisierungsthemen und Entwicklungen im Public Sector und kannst diese in Kundengesprächen adressieren
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren und Ausschreibungen und bewegst dich sicher im Umfeld des öffentlichen Einkaufs

Das bieten wir dir

description_html:

Deine Mission bei ]init[

Gestalte die Digitalisierung des Public Sector von morgen!
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, wie sich die deutsche Verwaltung modernisiert – sondern dein ganzes Know-how bei der Digitalisierung von Verwaltungsleistungen einsetzen? Sei es bei der Mitwirkung, bei der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller OZG-Verwaltungsleistungen nach dem Einer-für-Alle-Prinzip oder der Abschaffung aufwändiger Nachweispflichten für Bürger:innen und Unternehmen durch konsequente Umsetzung des Once Only-Prinzips durch die Registermodernisierung. Sei dabei als Consultant Public Sector (all genders) und das aus Hamburg heraus mit der Option auf Homeoffice!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du bist Teil der Consulting-Unit und verantwortlich für gestaltest (IT-)Beratungsprojekte mit
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden aus dem Public Sector in Projekten zur Umsetzung von Digitalisierungsvorhaben  
  • Du unterstützt in der Gestaltung von Strategien, Organisationen und Prozessen von Behörden der Bundes-, Landes- und Kommunalebene 
  • Du erarbeitest gemeinsam im Projektteam die Anforderungen des Kunden und entwirfst innovative Lösungsstrategien und -konzepte
  • Du bildest dich kontinuierlich fort durch Fortbildungen und teaminternen Wissenstransfer


Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Politikwissenschaft, Verwaltungswissenschaft, Verwaltungsinformatik, Rechtswissenschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik – oder einen anderen Hintergrund, der dich für das Tätigkeitsfeld qualifiziert. Auf bestimmte Studienrichtungen legen wir uns dabei bewusst nicht fest
  • Erste Praxis in der Beratung oder im IT-Projektmanagement – besonders freuen wir uns über Berührungspunkte mit der öffentlichen Verwaltung
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Projektplanung und -steuerung; PMFlex kennst du idealerweise bereits oder möchtest dich schnell darin einarbeiten
  • Freude daran, die Einführung neuer IT-Lösungen von der Vorbereitung über Pilotierung und Tests bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live zu begleiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür dafür, unterschiedliche Nutzer und Stakeholder bei Veränderungen mitzunehmen – ob in Workshops, Informationsveranstaltungen, Sprechstunden oder Schulungen
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und in Leitfäden, Handbüchern oder Unterlagen für die Gremienbeteiligung auf den Punkt zu bringen
  • Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an den Themen, die eine Systemeinführung mit sich bringt – von Konfiguration und Schnittstellen über Datenmigration und Customizing bis hin zu fachlichen und technischen Tests
  • Ein Blick dafür, was nach dem Go-live wichtig ist: Du denkst Support, Hypercare, Nutzerfeedback und den Übergang in stabile Betriebsstrukturen mit
  • Interesse an Verwaltungsdigitalisierung und daran, wie moderne IT-Services in öffentlichen Organisationen erfolgreich eingeführt und verankert werden
  • Kenntnisse rund um OZG, EfA, FIM, Datenschutz oder IT-Service Management sind ein Plus – wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du Lust hast, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten


Das bieten wir dir

  • Befristete Position auf 24 Monate: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, wertvolle Erfahrungen in einem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld zu sammeln
  • Because we care: Deine Work-Life-Balance liegt uns am Herzen. Aus diesem Grund sichern wir dir 30 Urlaubstage zu, flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Workation im EU-Ausland!
  • Work with us: Wir arbeiten deutschlandweit mobil zusammen - full-time oder im Teilzeitmodell deiner Wahl. Du entscheidest, wo du arbeiten möchtest.
  • Learn with us: In unserer ]init[ Akademie und mit zahlreichen Trainings im Jahr machen wir dich fit für deine Ziele & Herausforderungen. Eigne dir regelmäßig neue Kompetenzen an und wachse über dich hinaus, denn wir wollen, dass du gerne bei uns bist und dich nach deinen Interessen entwickeln kannst.
  • Grow with us: Lerne unsere Learning Lunches & Nutshells kennen, die dir neben deinem Einsatz in Projekten einen abteilungsübergreifenden Austausch ermöglichen. In unseren Teams unterstützen wir uns gegenseitig dabei, mutig zu denken, um gemeinsam den digitalen Wandel zu gestalten.
  • Ride with us: Du bleibst gerne in Bewegung? Wir bezuschussen dein ÖPNV-Ticket und entwickeln unsere Corporate Mobility Benefits kontinuierlich weiter - für dich und für mehr nachhaltige Mobilität in urbanen Räumen.
  • Start with us: Dein Einstieg ist vom ersten Moment an organisiert! Mit unserer virtuellen Welcome Week kommst du bei ]init[ richtig gut an. Eine enge Begleitung durch Patenschaften & Vernetzungsangebote gehören bei uns zu einem gelungenen Start dazu.

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. 
Du hast weitreichende Projekterfahrung in unterschiedlichen Kontexten gesammelt und große Projekte erfolgreich geleitet? Dann suchen wir Dich als (Senior) Project Manager (all genders), um mit uns gemeinsam digitale Lösungen für die eSociety zu realisieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst große IT-Projekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – agil, klassisch oder hybrid

  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace-Lösungen
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit zu Fragen der digitalen Transformation und berätst zu Lösungen aus dem ]init[-Portfolio
  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen

  • Websites, Intranets, Apps, digitale Antragssysteme oder Fachanwendungen: Du begeisterst dich für die Umsetzung von herausragenden IT-Projekten

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen oder klassischen Projektmethoden und rundest mit einer Zertifizierung idealerweise dein Profil ab (z.B. PMI/CAPM, Prince2, Scrum PSPO/PSM)
  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium 
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir
